This page serves as an overall table of contents for all the project documentation. 

# Data extraction and preparation

These scripts extract and tidy raw data for use further down the line. Where possible, the data is extract from its rawest possible form.

These scripts take available data (`data\raw_data`) and prepare it for use in this analysis (`data\prepped_data`). Where possible, the incoming data is in its raw, publicly available form (i.e. downloaded straight from the source). These scripts were run prior to completing the analysis below and do not need to be re-run when replicating the analysis - the data produced from the following scripts is available on request.

| Script | Dataset |
|:-------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------|
| [historical-sst.R](data-prep-scripts/historical-sst.R) | GHRSST, 0.25 degree resolution, MUR L4 analysis [@nasajpl_ghrsst_2015; @nasajpl_ghrsst_2019] |
| [aquaculture-production-data.R](data-prep-scripts\aquaculture-production-data.R) | FAO aquaculture production data [@fao_fishstat_2026] |
| [mariculture-locations.R](data-prep-scripts\mariculture-locations.R) | Aquaculture siting maps [@clawson_mapping_2022; @clawson_mapping_2022_data] |
| [EEZ-data.R](data-prep-scripts\EEZ-data.R) | TBD |
| [ESGF-data.R](data-prep-scripts\ESGF-data.R) | TBD |
| [ESGF-temperature-corrections.R](data-prep-scripts\ESGF-temperature-corrections.R) | TBD |

# Main analysis

These scripts run the actual processes and analysis for the project, using the data prepared by the script above. These markdowns must be run in order as they rely on data generated by previous scripts and markdowns.

## Setup

| Script | Description |
|:---------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| [00_model_function_demonstration.qmd](documentation-qmds/00_model_function_demonstration.html) | A demonstration of the basic bioenergetic model functions (adapted from @baldan_r_2018), their outputs, and some useful wrappers for individual- and farm-level simulation. Uses illustrative Atlantic salmon parameters and saves no data. |
| [01_choosing_species.qmd](documentation-qmds/01_choosing_species.html) | Identifies the most-produced fed marine and brackishwater aquaculture species using FAO data from 2011 onwards, ranked by cumulative production volume. Assesses the coverage trade-offs of different species subsets and curates a final list of 17 representative bioenergetic models. Saves the species and production lookups used by all later scripts. |
| [02_assigning_locations.qmd](documentation-qmds/02_assigning_locations.html) | Assigns farm locations to each model name according to previously-mapped mariculture locations [@clawson_mapping_2022], or temperature-based habitat suitability if mapped locations are missing. Farm counts per country and species are derived from FAO production, and farms are allocated with an integer linear programme based on days spent within each species' thermal range. Extracts and saves mean-year historical SST for every assigned farm. |

## Species parameterisation

Each of these documents follows the same pipeline for one species: load raw parameters from `parameters_species.xlsx` and a representative feed formulation, run a representative individual at the mean farm SST, check the outputs, run a ±10% parameter sensitivity analysis, then calibrate parameters via Latin Hypercube Sampling against the target weight change from stocking to commercial size. Each saves a calibrated parameter set to `data/prepped_data/species_parameters/`. [03_03_check_species_seabream.qmd](documentation-qmds/03_03_check_species_seabream.html) contains the fullest description of the methodology.

## Future temperatures and production

| Script | Description |
|:---------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| [04_extracting_future_temperatures.qmd](documentation-qmds/04_extracting_future_temperatures.html) | Extracts bias-corrected future SST projections (EC-Earth3P-HR, corrected against 2015–2024 observed SST) for 2025–2099 at every assigned farm location. Farms falling on missing or inland cells are filled from progressively wider neighbourhoods, or from the nearest non-missing farm. Saves per-farm and per-model temperature time series. |
| [05_00_test_production.qmd](documentation-qmds/05_00_test_production.html) | Prototypes the future production simulation using seabream on a subset of farms. Compares three strategies for handling warming-driven changes in growth: letting harvested biomass float, letting grow-out duration adapt, or letting farm population adapt to hold harvested biomass constant. Used to decide the approach taken in 05_01. |
| [05_01_run_production.qmd](documentation-qmds/05_01_run_production.html) | Runs the full future production simulation (2025–2099) for all species and farms. Pairs each farm with a feed formulation, sets grow-out windows and harvest population from 2025 baseline temperatures, then runs the farm model with 5000 Monte Carlo individuals per farm and harvest year. Saves per-farm results to `outputs/data/farm_production/`. Run repeatedly per species–feed subset. |
| [05_02_consolidate_results.qmd](documentation-qmds/05_02_consolidate_results.html) | Checks which species–feed combinations have completed production runs, produces per-farm diagnostic plots (harvested biomass, feed required, FCR), and aggregates farm-level results up to country and FAO-region level. Saves consolidated outputs to `outputs/data/consolidated/`. |

## Results exploration and visualisation

| Script | Description |
|:---------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| [06_explore_production.qmd](documentation-qmds/06_explore_production.html) | Exploratory look at production outputs (currently Norway): farm maps and changes in biomass, feed provided, and feed per unit biomass over 2025–2099. Also tests how many Monte Carlo individuals are needed for stable farm-level estimates, justifying the 5000 used in 05_01. |
| [07_habitat_suitability.qmd](documentation-qmds/07_habitat_suitability.html) | Computes temperature-based habitat suitability for every species across all countries' EEZs for each year 2025–2099, using two mechanisms: feeding response and metabolic surplus at half commercial weight. Saves per-country, per-species, per-year rasters to `outputs/data/habitat_suitability/`. The consolidation section is still in progress. |
